source.title: Analysis of Carbon Dioxide in Air

table.selection: All rows printed in Table A1. No rows excluded or filled in.
table.signal_meaning: Instrument response Sig in the source, not raw light intensity. Signal units are not specified in Table A1.
table.signal_sd_meaning: Printed Sig_sd, standard deviation of N instrument readings.
table.n_meaning: Number of readings used for each printed signal mean.
table.flag_meaning: Original printed quality marker, a dot on all rows.
table.ratio_meaning: Sample response divided by mean of bracketing reference responses.
table.x626_meaning: Dry-air mole fraction of 16O12C16O, NOT total CO2, in micromol/mol (ppm).
table.missing_data: Reference after last SMP at 12:21:16 is not printed. Its ratio is used as published, not reconstructed.
table.rounding: Published signals have four decimals. Reconstructed ratios may differ from printed ratios due to rounding. Calibration uses the published ratios.

calibration.scope: Coefficients printed for this 2017 episode only. The table does not explicitly state the scale version for this episode. Do not relabel these values as X2019.
